description:
National market data for the German residential real estate market. Sources: DESTATIS, vdp, HYPOPORT.

Includes price AND transaction indices for various market segments.

Parameters:
- zeitraum: "jahr" (default) | "quartal"
  - jahr: all price and transaction indices, regional and per source
  - quartal: only the Germany-wide price indices of DESTATIS, vdp and HYPOPORT, current up to the second-to-last quarter; periode like "2026-Q2"; DESTATIS arrives one quarter after the other two

Time filters:
- start/end: flexible date values (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD)
- recent: number of most recent periods (years or quarters)

Response controls:
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Changes per index:
- *_delta_1j / *_delta_proz_1j: change vs. previous year (quarterly: vs. same quarter a year earlier)
- *_delta_1q / *_delta_proz_1q: change vs. previous quarter (zeitraum=quartal only)

The regional price indices and all transaction indices exist for zeitraum=jahr only.

Key response fields (German names):
- preisindex_gesamt_destatis: Residential property price index from the Federal Statistical Office (base year = 100)
- preisindex_gesamt_vdp: Residential property price index from the Association of German Pfandbrief Banks (base year = 100)
- preisindex_gesamt_hypoport: Residential property price index from Hypoport/Europace (base year = 100)
- preisindex_landkreise_kreisfreie_staedte: Price index for residential properties in all counties and independent cities (base year = 100)
- preisindex_grossstaedte_top_7: Price index for Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf (base year = 100)
- preisindex_staedte_top_127: Price index for residential properties in the 127 largest German cities (base year = 100)
- transaktionsindex_landkreise_kreisfreie_staedte: Transaction index for residential properties in all counties and independent cities (base year = 100)
- transaktionsindex_grossstaedte_top_7: Transaction index for Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf (base year = 100)
- transaktionsindex_staedte_top_127: Transaction index for residential properties in the 127 largest German cities (base year = 100)

end.description: Ende des Zeitraums (YYYY, YYYY-MM oder YYYY-MM-DD)

recent.description: Anzahl der aktuellsten Perioden. Mutually exclusive mit start/end.

start.description: Beginn des Zeitraums (YYYY, YYYY-MM oder YYYY-MM-DD)

zeitraum.description: Zeitliche Aggregation: jahr (alle Indizes) oder quartal (nur die Deutschland-Preisindizes von Destatis, vdp und Hypoport)
